title: Compressed Air System, IoT Field Engineer

cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. [Company name masked] uses IoT technology and predictive analytics to automate air compressor systems, improving energy efficiency, system reliability, and off-site productivity.
We're seeking a Compressed Air IoT Field Engineer to lead the installation and commissioning of our IoT-based industrial air compressor controls platform.
Bring your hands-on experience with industrial compressed air systems and your knowledge of IT networking protocols to help push this work forward. You'll be part of a team connecting traditional mechanical systems with modern technology.
You will own the onsite installation process of the [Product name masked] system end to end. This includes deploying sensors, managing wiring, configuring edge devices, and integrating components into the compressor controller. You'll work closely with [Company name masked] service experts to develop installation plans and troubleshoot onsite challenges, and you'll act as site lead, directing external contractors to ensure clean execution.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Create installation plans based on finalized as-builts to ensure the efficient and effective installation of all necessary components. Take ownership of the onsite installation process, encompassing tasks such as running CAT6 cable, safely installing flow and pressure sensors through the hot tap process, mounting NEMA boxes, executing terminations, and integrating with the compressor controller. Program all necessary IoT devices and assume the role of site leader, overseeing the work of personnel, including contractors, as needed. Partnering with the [Company name masked] Tech Support team, ensure proper operation of all equipment and accurate data flow in collaboration with the Tech Support Team before departing from the site, as well as working with them to improve the pre-install and on-site installation processes. Serve as [Company name masked]'s onsite liaison, promptly relaying any issues or observations to Tech Support to facilitate efficient oversight and problem resolution. Lead the on-site troubleshooting efforts to complete root cause analysis and implement fixes. Communicate clearly with the customer point of contact regarding any issues, progress updates, and to ensure alignment on the overall installation process. Complete post-trip documentation, including but not limited to trip reports, communicating issues, updating as-built documentation, etc.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree in a related technical field or 10+ years related experience
Minimum 5 years of experience with industrial compressed air systems (repair, maintenance, and/or audit)
Ability to read schematics and P&IDs
Strong communication skills and technical problem-solving skills
Knowledge of networking concepts including ethernet, network devices, wireless, ISP, IP, internet protocol, device bus, SCADA, hubs, switches, routers, bridges, gateways, modems, repeaters, LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, VLAN, WiFi, access points, cables, connectivity, RS485, CANbus, MODbus, Discrete I/O
Ability to travel 50% of the time
Access to a major airport
Not eligible for Visa sponsorship
Preferred Requirements
Basic industrial IT / networking experience with willingness to learn new skills of installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols
Basic IT / Networking knowledge and willingness to learn
Proficient computer skills with ability to work independently and guide the work of others

We're seeking a Compressed Air IoT Field Engineer to lead the installation and commissioning of our IoT-based industrial air compressor controls platform.
Bring your hands-on experience with industrial compressed air systems and your knowledge of IT networking protocols to help push this work forward. You'll be part of a team connecting traditional mechanical systems with modern technology.
You will own the onsite installation process of the [Product name masked] system end to end. Partnering with the [Company name masked] Tech Support team, ensure proper operation of all equipment and accurate data flow in collaboration with the Tech Support Team before departing from the site, as well as working with them to improve the pre-install and on-site installation processes. Serve as [Company name masked]'s onsite liaison, promptly relaying any issues or observations to Tech Support to facilitate efficient oversight and problem resolution. Communicate clearly with the customer point of contact regarding any issues, progress updates, and to ensure alignment on the overall installation process. Complete post-trip documentation, including but not limited to trip reports, communicating issues, updating as-built documentation, etc.

We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. [Company name masked] uses IoT technology and predictive analytics to automate air compressor systems, improving energy efficiency, system reliability, and off-site productivity.
There's a transition underway in manufacturing. We're seeking a Compressed Air IoT Field Engineer to lead the installation and commissioning of our IoT-based industrial air compressor controls platform.
Bring your hands-on experience with industrial compressed air systems and your knowledge of IT networking protocols to help push this work forward. It's an opportunity to be part of a team connecting traditional mechanical systems with newer technology.
You will own the onsite installation process of the [Product name masked] system from start to finish. This includes deploying sensors, managing wiring, configuring edge devices, and integrating all components into the compressor controller. Most people become stronger in this kind of field installation work over time as they build experience and learn from each job.

There's a transition underway in manufacturing. We're seeking a Compressed Air IoT Field Engineer to lead the installation and commissioning of our IoT-based industrial air compressor controls platform.
Bring your hands-on experience with industrial compressed air systems and your knowledge of IT networking protocols to help push this work forward. It's an opportunity to be part of a team connecting traditional mechanical systems with newer technology.
You will own the onsite installation process of the [Product name masked] system from start to finish. This includes deploying sensors, managing wiring, configuring edge devices, and integrating all components into the compressor controller. Communicate clearly with the customer point of contact regarding any issues, progress updates, and to ensure alignment on the overall installation process. cond_0362.intro:
We are looking for a Compressed Air IoT Field Engineer to join our team. [Company name masked] uses IoT technology and predictive analytics to automate air compressor systems, improving energy efficiency, system reliability, and off-site productivity.
As a pivotal team member, you will own the comprehensive, onsite installation process of the [Product name masked] system from start to finish. This includes deploying sensors, managing wiring intricacies, configuring edge devices, and seamlessly integrating all components into the compressor controller. Collaborating closely with fellow [Company name masked] service experts, you will develop installation plans and troubleshoot any challenges that arise onsite. Additionally, you will assume the role of site lead, overseeing and directing the activities of external contractors to ensure flawless execution.
cond_0362.responsibilities: Create installation plans based on finalized as-builts to ensure the efficient and effective installation of all necessary components. Program all necessary IoT devices and assume the role of site leader, overseeing the work of personnel, including contractors, as needed. Serve as [Company name masked]'s onsite liaison, promptly relaying any issues or observations to Tech Support to facilitate efficient oversight and problem resolution. Lead the on-site troubleshooting efforts to complete root cause analysis and implement fixes. Communicate clearly with the customer point of contact regarding any issues, progress updates, and to ensure alignment on the overall installation process. Complete post-trip documentation, including but not limited to trip reports, communicating issues, updating as-built documentation, etc.

Minimum Requirements
Associate degree in a related technical field, or 10+ years of demonstrated expertise in a related technical discipline

Exceptional communication skills and strong technical problem-solving abilities
Ability to travel 50% of the time
Access to a major airport
